identity.political_identity_rule: Earth, Federation civil government and Starfleet institutions are separate entities.

orbital_context.strategic_context: Federation capital system throughout retained playable eras.

bulk_physics.policy: Use real-Earth astronomy where authoritative physical data is required; no invented Trek deviations without source.

atmosphere.notes: Baseline Human environment; species-specific comfort/medical checks still use biology profiles.

climate_refs: real Earth climate plus dated Trek-era environmental state when gameplay requires
institutional_anchors: major Sol-system fleet/defense/logistics facilities generated or authored separately
temporal_rules: Future attacks, wars or political changes are not forced after campaign start.
Earth remains physical world even if political capital/status changes.
ai_boundary: AI cannot treat Earth customs as universal Human or Federation culture.
AI cannot invent unrestricted access to Starfleet/Federation facilities.
Planetary security and traffic use live World State.
visual_nap: Preserve recognizable real geography where shown.
Trek-era architecture overlays must be era-specific.
Do not turn Earth into generic futuristic megacity everywhere.
unknowns: exact campaign-era population by playable year unless sourced
